seo.title: Duolingo: AI customer agent (Decagon) - 80 percent chat deflection (2024)
seo.meta_description: In 2024, Duolingo deployed the Decagon AI agent and deflected 80 percent of its chat volume, versus 30 percent with the previous vendor.
seo.resume_citable: In 2024, Duolingo deployed Decagon's AI support agent on its chat and deflected 80 percent of incoming volume, versus 30 percent with the previous vendor, with go-live in about one month.

faq.q: What deflection rate did Duolingo get with Decagon?
faq.a: 80 percent of incoming chat volume, versus 30 percent with the previous vendor, according to Decagon's case study quoting a Duolingo operations manager.

faq.q: How long did the deployment take?
faq.a: About one month between the first discussions and go-live on chat, with email planned for early 2025.

objectif_business: Bring down the ticket volume handled by humans and the time the team spends maintaining the support tool, on a base of several hundred million users.
description: Duolingo deployed Decagon's AI support agent on its chat in 2024. The agent deflects 80 percent of incoming chat volume, versus 30 percent with the previous vendor. Setup took about one month from the first discussions to go-live. Email was planned for early 2025. The switch also lightened the team's load: automatic hourly sync of the FAQ, less manual maintenance, and human agents refocused on complex cases. Duolingo claims a base of 500 million users, which gives a sense of the contact volume absorbed.
points_cles: AI support agent deployed on in-app chat, then extended to email.
The Decagon platform built on OpenAI models, with the FAQ synced hourly.
80% chat deflection versus 30% before, go-live in about one month.

resultats.metrique: Chat deflection rate, versus 30 percent with the previous vendor

niveau_preuve.justification: A quantified case study from the Decagon platform with a named, quoted person (Ian Riggins); cross-checked by the OpenAI customer story on Decagon. A clear deflection figure but from an interested source, hence level B.

stack_technique.detail: AI support agent platform deployed on in-app chat; 80 percent deflection versus 30 with the previous vendor.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time on chat, with automatic hourly sync of the FAQ base.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Duolingo's support operations team, with Decagon Agent Product Managers and engineers supporting at launch.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The deflection rate and the accuracy of the answers. The system relies on an FAQ synced hourly; if this base drifts, answer quality drops and volume returns to humans.

etapes.detail: Wire the FAQ and procedures so the agent answers on up-to-date content, with automatic hourly sync.
Deploy the agent on incoming chat; the switch took about one month.
The agent resolves the majority of requests without a human (80 percent), and surfaces complex cases.
Human agents focus on complex cases; the tool's maintenance load collapses.

replication.premiere_etape: Audit the existing FAQ and clean it up: it drives the agent's quality, even before choosing the tool.

playbook.action: Audit and clean the FAQ and procedures: this base drives the agent's quality.
Connect the base to the agent platform and configure automatic sync.
Test answer accuracy internally and define the escalation rules to humans.
Go live on chat and track the deflection rate.
playbook.livrable: Agent live on chat with a deflection dashboard

playbook.action: Extend to email and refocus the support team on complex cases.
playbook.livrable: A second channel covered, maintenance load reduced

replication.equipe: 1 support operations lead (FAQ owner) + 1 dev for the connectors; the vendor provides Agent Product Managers at launch.

statut_vivant.note: The case is still published by Decagon and the scope extended toward email in 2025. Decagon has also consolidated a base of large accounts, which makes withdrawal unlikely.

transposable_ue.note: A low-stakes consumer app support case. Under the GDPR, plan for transparency about the automated interaction and a human path; few sensitive data involved compared with fintech or healthcare.
